newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo urges closer LatAm trade ties.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo urges closer LatAm trade ties.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo, welcoming his Uruguayan counterpart Julio Maria Sanguinetti on a four-day visit to Mexico, called Wednesday for closer trade links between Latin American nations.

"We Mexicans have proposed as a medium-term objective...that we begin negotiating an accord to significantly deepen trade liberalization between Mexico and Mercosur," Zedillo said in a speech at the welcoming ceremony.
Uruguay is a member of the Mercosur trading bloc with Argentina, Paraguay and Brazil.
Mexico belongs to the North American Free Trade Agreement with Canada and the United States and also has a free trade with Chile.
The two presidents also signed a bilateral extradition treaty. Sanguinetti arrived in Mexico Tuesday and is scheduled to leave for France Friday.
